name: Tales of Lemma 1
source:
Tales of Lemma 1 is the first game in a series of visual ren'ai short stories. The star is a cute young 19-year-old woman named Miko, with whom the player gets lost in the wilderness. Being more of a practice game, ToL 1 is pretty short, but it should give you a nice smile and a chuckle or two! =:-) 

[From the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110317064158/http://www.lemmasoft.net/games_tol1.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
《Lemma的故事1》是恋爱短篇视觉小说系列的第一部作品。主角是一名可爱的19岁少女，名叫美子；玩家会与她一同在荒野中迷失。作为一部练习性质更强的作品，《Lemma的故事1》十分短小，但相信能让你会心一笑，轻轻笑出声来！=:-)

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110317064158/http://www.lemmasoft.net/games_tol1.html]官方网站[/url]]
